title: Synthesis of novel chiral Schiff bases and their application in asymmetric transfer hydrogenation of prochiral ketones
abstract: AbstractNovel chiral Schiff bases were synthesized from (+)‐camphor, and their application to asymmetric transfer hydrogenation of prochiral ketones is described. The asymmetric transfer hydrogenation reaction could afford excellent conversion rates (up to 97.3%) and up to 27.3% enantiomeric excess. © 2008 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 19:682–687, 2008; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.20494
